obligations.name: variational principle
obligations.statement: for a bounded self-adjoint H, inf sigma(H) = inf of Rayleigh quotients over any dense subspace (here: finitely supported vectors)

obligations.name: compression
obligations.statement: lambda_min(P_K H P_K) >= inf sigma(H) for every subspace

obligations.name: Higham Theorem 10.3
obligations.statement: if floating-point Cholesky of an n x n symmetric A completes, L L^T = A + dA with |dA| <= gamma_{n+1}|L||L^T|; the certificate uses ||dA||_2 <= gamma_{n+1}||L||_F^2 and an IEEE model with u = 2^-52 (two ulps, covering FMA)
obligations.status: cited (Higham 2002), not re-proved; implementation-dependent assumption: LAPACK dpbtrf obeys the standard rounding model

obligations.name: overlap function
obligations.statement: c(eta) for the Dirichlet ground state of the unit 3-ball (Plancherel; symbolic derivation in phase11_proofs.overlap3d)
obligations.status: derived symbolically in Phase XI; the radial Fourier transform step is classical analysis

obligations.name: spin lift
obligations.statement: every R in SO(3) has a lift W in SU(2) with W sigma.v W^+ = sigma.(R v)
obligations.status: standard; for the 24 rotations used here the lift is exhibited and checked exactly (orbit_link_exact)

obligations.name: cycle spectrum
obligations.statement: the free operator of an l-cycle with holonomy W has spectrum {2 - 2cos((phi + 2 pi m)/l)}

obligations.name: closure lemma
obligations.statement: every child 1-star lies inside sigma of its parent 1-star
obligations.status: finite, asserted on every Phi step of every run (not a general proof for all rules)

obligations.name: primitivity and minimality
obligations.statement: M^2 > 0 for the frame substitution implies a minimal hull
obligations.status: standard for primitive substitutions; M^2 > 0 checked per rule
